targets.query:
ban = ["timestamp", "LabviewTime", "LabViewTime", "StepNumber", "Cycle"]
componentSel = if "${component}" == "" then "ALL" else "${component}"

from(bucket: "source-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._field, set: ban))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => componentSel == "ALL" or r._field == componentSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement"])

panels.title: Global anomaly score per event — v1 vs v2

targets.query:
from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "score_a")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "score v1" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "Group", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["Group", "_field"])

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "score_b")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "score v2" }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "Group", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["Group", "_field"])

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "warming_up_a" or r._field == "warming_up_b")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "Group", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["Group", "_field"])

panels.title: Global score difference per event (score_diff / abs_diff)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "score_diff" or r._field == "abs_diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "Group", "_field"])
  |> group(columns: ["Group", "_field"])

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "identical")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r._value)

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "abs_diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group()
  |> max()

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "identical" and r._value == 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "complete_int" and r._value == 0)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group()
  |> count()

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "identical" and exists r._value)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group()
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))

from(bucket: "repeatability-diff")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-diff")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "emit_reason" or r._field == "identical" or r._field == "complete_int")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id", "emit_reason", "identical", "complete_int"])
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)

list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "array"

all = array.from(rows: [{_value: "ALL"}])

groups =
  schema.tagValues(
    bucket: "repeatability-v1",
    tag: "Group",
    predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "repeatability-v1",
    start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z,
  )
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

union(tables: [all, groups])
  |> group()

components =
  from(bucket: "source-data")
    |> range(start: 2020-01-01T00:00:00Z)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data")
    |> keep(columns: ["_field"])
    |> group()
    |> distinct(column: "_field")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._value, set: ban))

  |> group()
